description:
Looking for 2 - 3 Teammates. Need to know at least 1 of the following languages: PHP, C++, HTML, CSS

In this project we will extensively use Github/flow.

API's will also be used to calculate the finalized data so knowledge in that field will be necessary.
summary:
This project uses PHP, HTML and C++, PHP handling the communications between the HTML front-end and the C++ back-end.

the program sends a request to the NASA horizons API and outputs data that it calculates with the data sent back from the API

it also shows a visual representation of the moon to the user.
details:
i used PHP, HTML and C++ to request data from the horizons API and calculate data needed and output it to the user

i used neovim and github to develop this project
